name: Farm View Restaurant
description: Renowned local destination for authentic Agri and Wadvali style coastal seafood, whole pomfret fry, surmai rassa, and hot tandlachi bhakri in an open-air rustic garden setting.
address: Bhavani Shankar Mandir Road, Near Agashi Church, Agashi, Virar West

name: Hotel Lion Zion
description: Popular sea-breeze family restaurant situated near Navapur beach road, offering authentic coastal fish platters, crab masala, and chilled solkadhi with sunset views.
address: Navapur Beach Road, Near Arnala Coastal Belt, Virar West

name: Malvan Cho Kalvan
description: Specialist Malvani restaurant known for rich coconut and triphala based fish curries, jawla koliwada, prawns sukka, and authentic Konkan thalis near Virar station.
address: Station Road, Opp. Platform 1 West, Virar West

name: On The Way Family Restaurant & Bar
description: Spacious family dining establishment located on Bolinj road featuring North Indian, Chinese, and fresh catch seafood specials with dedicated family seating.
address: Bolinj Agashi Road, Near Viva College Road, Bolinj, Virar West

name: Hotel Bageecha
description: Long-established garden restaurant in the lush Agashi area, popular with weekend travelers and families enjoying fried Bombay duck, surmai masala, and tandoori specials.
address: Agashi Bolinj Road, Near Petrol Pump, Agashi, Virar West

name: The Post Office Bistro
description: Vibrant and cozy modern café near Viva College campus, well-known for artisanal faloodas, grilled sandwiches, shakes, and wood-fired pizzas.
address: Shop 4, Near New Viva College, Bolinj Road, Virar West

name: Ratan's Sea Food & Bar
description: Casual beachside seafood retreat on the way to Arnala fort, serving fresh Arabian sea catch including whole pomfret, kolambi koliwada, and crab curry.
address: Arnala Beach Road, Near Jakat Naka, Arnala, Virar West
